context: Daichi and Mei discuss reaching a central town.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: travel chat; transport vocabulary (移動/道路/整備/中央/平均) in natural home.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 中央の町まで、行ってみたいなあ。
lines.en: I'd like to go to the central town.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 道路は、整備されているんですか?
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 最近、道路がきれいに整備されたんよ。
lines.en: Recently the roads were nicely repaved.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm friendly delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 移動の時間は、平均でどのくらい?
lines.en: On average, how long is the trip?
lines.style: curious woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 平均で、二時間ほどの移動やね。
lines.en: On average, about a two-hour trip.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm informative delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 中央まで、まっすぐ行けますか?
lines.en: Can we go straight to the center?
lines.style: thoughtful woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 整備された道路で、中央まで一本や。
lines.en: On the paved road, it's straight to the center.
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm reassuring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 移動が楽なら、行きやすいですね。
lines.en: If travel's easy, it's easy to visit.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm closing delivery throughout
